lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the pectoral fin attachment, forming distinct vertical columns and horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary spot clusters, creating a grid-like visual structure where spots act as nodes within the vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow gradient immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, randomly distributed high-luminance blobs; several elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (likely remoras) are visible in the ventral water column.
